title: Free Fries, One RULE 🍟
description:
The fries at this diner are free, every day, forever. Two yellow gloves slide each basket out of the hatch, and nobody has ever seen the cook.

My best friend and I are broke, so we're here every afternoon. There's only one rule, and he just bet me his last dollar I'd break it.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
